divergence.title: 2026 Property-Type Dynamics: Single-Family vs. Condominiums
divergence.summary: Why total closings jumped +13.3% while the combined median price held at $525,000:

items.heading: Single-Family Homes
items.detail: Continued price appreciation (+2.4% YoY to $430,000 region-wide), rising pending sales (+5.3%), and tightening active inventory (-12.7%).

items.heading: Condos & Townhomes
items.detail: Surging buyer velocity (+22.4% YTD closed sales growth) paired with realistic seller pricing (-4.8% median price adjustment to $330,000) as associations completed milestone reserve adjustments.
